Orbit **1.1.0** — One library for Mac and Windows Steam games, with in-app Wine and GPTK.

## Highlights

- **One library** — Installed, All games, and Favorites share a single grid. A Steam title is one card, whether you own it, have it installed, or both
- **Windows Steam on Mac** — sign in from Settings with a QR code or your Steam account, browse what you own, download a Windows depot, and play it through Wine or GPTK
- **Compatibility in Settings** — install Wine, DXVK, DXMT, MoltenVK, and Apple Game Porting Toolkit from Orbit. Graphics options apply only when that backend is actually installed
- **Your Steam folders** — add an extra `steamapps` library (including one that happens to live under GameHub) and those installs show up as Installed
- **Details you can edit** — General, Artwork, and Launch & compatibility now live on the game page. There is no separate properties screen

## What's included

### Added

- Unified library with Installed / All games / Favorites, bounded pages, and search across the owned catalog (capped at 2,000)
- Windows Steam sign-in (QR or account). The password is RSA-encrypted to Steam and never stored
- Owned-library snapshot, one Windows download at a time, and play through the existing compatibility runtime
- Downloads sidebar in the shell for the active transfer
- Settings → Compatibility: Wine, DXVK, DXMT, MoltenVK, and GPTK catalog installs with checksum verification
- Settings → Library: additional Steam library folders (`steamapps/common` or its parent)
- Game details Settings (General / Artwork / Launch & compatibility)
- Unified library commands (`list_library_entries`, `get_library_entry`, `update_library_entry`, `delete_library_entry`, `scan_steam_installations`) and the Windows Steam command group

### Changed

- Library search, sort, and platform filters are separate 48px Liquid Glass clusters, matching the header
- Settings uses a controller-first sidebar: General, Themes, Library, Steam, Game graphics, Compatibility
- Steam store descriptions replace importer placeholder copy when a Steam identity is known

### Removed

- GameHub as a provider: no shortcut scan, `gamehub://` handoff, or GameHub library screen. Point Settings → Library at the Steam folder instead. Unmatched GameHub rows leave the active library only after a SQLite backup; installed files are never moved or deleted

### Fixed

- Compact shell header no longer overflows around 900px; Settings content scrolls inside the glass pane
- Windows executable discovery checks shallower directories first so large asset folders cannot hide the game `.exe`

## Setup

**Steam (Windows games on Mac):** Settings → Steam → sign in with QR or account. Open a title that is not installed, download it, then Play. One download at a time.

**Compatibility:** Settings → Compatibility → Install compatibility (Wine) and pick DXVK, DXMT, or GPTK as needed. Apple GPTK uses Apple’s license and published packages.

**Existing Steam libraries:** Settings → Library → add a `steamapps/common` folder, its `steamapps` parent, or the library root.

Games that require a silent Steam client inside the Wine prefix can still fail to start. That in-prefix client is not in this release.

## Install

**Requirements:** macOS 12+, Apple Silicon (CI publishes `aarch64` builds).

1. Download **`Orbit-1.1.0-aarch64.dmg`** below
2. Open the DMG and drag **Orbit** to Applications
3. Launch from Applications — grant permissions if macOS prompts for file access

Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## Build from source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/LFSCamargo/orbit.git
cd orbit
yarn install
yarn tauri:dev
yarn release:macos
```

See [RUNNING.md](https://github.com/LFSCamargo/orbit/blob/main/RUNNING.md), [docs/STEAM_WINDOWS.md](https://github.com/LFSCamargo/orbit/blob/main/docs/STEAM_WINDOWS.md), and [docs/RUNTIMES.md](https://github.com/LFSCamargo/orbit/blob/main/docs/RUNTIMES.md).
